item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-df7b6152febcc8ab","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The study describes Xi Jinping's common-prosperity strategy as an official program tied to the 14th Five-Year Plan and 2035 goals, emphasizing coordinated efficiency and fairness, primary/secondary/tertiary distribution, expansion of middle-income groups, regulation of high incomes, and rural prosperity.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.8","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The source was published in 2023 and describes the governing program in force during 2023; implementation and outcomes within 2023 are not established.","ruler_attribution":"The program is attributed to Xi Jinping and the Chinese Communist Party.","limitations":["The supplied extract provides programmatic claims and a bibliography, but no independently reported 2023 execution or distribution outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-62f85b32f9b9f1f5","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"A nationwide vignette experiment with 5,527 Chinese citizens found a hierarchical corruption–competence tradeoff: respondents preferred competent but corrupt low-level officials over honest but incompetent ones, while that preference disappeared for high-level local officials.","question_ids":["7B.5","7B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published online in April 2023; the experiment concerns public evaluations of Chinese officials and is relevant to the 2023 institutional context, but does not directly measure Xi's personal conduct.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Chinese local officials generally, not Xi Jinping personally.","limitations":["The extract does not report direct evidence about Xi's appointments, family interests, or procurement decisions.","Vignette preferences are not the same as observed institutional behavior."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c5566193948bcbdb","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The article reports that during the first three years of Xi Jinping's anticorruption campaign, some of China's major political and military figures and tens of thousands of cadres were implicated; it characterizes the campaign as coupled with administrative reform and disciplinary regulation to change political norms and practices.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.6","7B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2016; it documents the campaign's institutional design and early implementation, which remained part of Xi's governing system in 2023, but does not establish 2023 results.","ruler_attribution":"The campaign and associated reforms are attributed to Xi Jinping's leadership.","limitations":["The extract does not establish whether enforcement was politically impartial or whether Xi and close associates were independently investigated.","The source predates 2023 and provides no end-period assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cde1262aef7c5185","start_unit":6,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"The issue includes studies finding that Xi formed a dominant faction and promoted provincial clients at unusually high rates; state information control focused on managing influential users and limiting non-Party leadership; and a centrally planned national-victory narrative was implemented through school curricula, museums, and diplomacy.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.3","4B.5","4B.6","4B.9","7B.5","8B.4","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The studies were published in 2021 and analyze Xi-era institutions and policies that continued into 2023; they do not provide a distinct 2023 event.","ruler_attribution":"The factional promotion, information-control strategy, and official narrative are associated with Xi Jinping's China and the CCP.","limitations":["The supplied extract is an issue table of contents and abstracts, not the full underlying articles.","The evidence does not by itself establish Xi's personal direction of every reported local or media action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3d2e04afd055a010","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Textual analysis of CCP political documents finds that Xi Jinping's ideology expanded his dominance and compressed space for power-sharing among political elites; the study also finds that the ideology lacked sufficient empirical content for self-validation and had not been fully established within the official ideological system.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.5","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2023 and based on Xi-era political documents; the extract does not isolate a specific 2023 document or outcome.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern Xi Jinping's ideological system and its role in CCP elite politics.","limitations":["This is an interpretive doctoral study rather than an independent audit of policy implementation.","The extract does not quantify the extent of elite exclusion or identify specific 2023 decisions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-013ee4692f4bd197","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Analysis of Xi Jinping's provincial inspections from 2012 to 2022 finds that he embedded inspections in his regular schedule, sought to visit all provincial-level regions in each term, used recurring core staff, and shifted administrative emphasis toward ideological party-building and responses to the U.S.-China trade war and COVID-19.","question_ids":["8B.1","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The source was published in 2023 but its empirical period ends in October 2022; it informs the inherited operating pattern at the start of 2023 rather than a 2023 event.","ruler_attribution":"The inspection pattern and agenda allocation are attributed to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The source relies substantially on official news reports.","It does not establish whether inspections produced durable improvements across all regions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-013ee4692f4bd197","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Case studies of characteristic-town construction and black-soil protection find that Xi's inspections allocated bureaucratic attention, helped trigger central policies, and accelerated local policy diffusion; repeated inspections of the same policy also indicated that local officials tended to infer and follow the top leader's preferences rather than act autonomously.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The study covers 2012-2022 and was published in 2023; it provides evidence about policy mechanisms entering 2023, not a separate 2023 outcome.","ruler_attribution":"The attention allocation and repeated inspections are attributed to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The extract does not provide quantified national outcomes for either policy.","The inference about officials' motives is based on case analysis."]},{"source_id":"SRC-bf9f5b5edc4548f4","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The study finds that after the 20th Party Congress, advanced semiconductor innovation and military-civil fusion remained central national priorities despite Xi Jinping's emphasis on secure development; China used nationwide funds and authority but had not achieved expected advanced-semiconductor R&D and manufacturing results, and shifted toward overseas alliances, technical cooperation, acquisitions, and talent recruitment.","question_ids":["1B.9","5B.1","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2023 and explicitly addresses the post-20th-Congress period, including the 2023 policy context.","ruler_attribution":"The national semiconductor and military-civil-fusion priorities are attributed to Xi Jinping's government.","limitations":["The source is a thesis abstract and does not provide a complete accounting of spending, specific acquisitions, or 2023 performance indicators.","Military-civil fusion creates dual-use and catastrophic-risk concerns, but the extract does not document a specific harmful incident."]},{"source_id":"SRC-277cde070eca40cd","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The thesis frames climate change as an area of both fundamental U.S.-China interest divergence and urgent need for cooperation, and studies how Xi-era China used climate discourse, international mechanisms, meetings, foreign cooperation, and aid to build international influence.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.4","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2023 and covers the Xi era; the extract does not identify a distinct 2023 climate decision or implementation result.","ruler_attribution":"The climate-dis course strategy is attributed to Xi-era China and Xi Jinping's leadership.","limitations":["The supplied extract describes the research design and scope but does not state the thesis's concrete findings on emissions, compliance, or negotiated outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c61632bb39574c15","start_unit":9,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"The study reports that Xi's government began its anticorruption campaign after the 2012 18th Party Congress; hundreds of thousands of officials were investigated or disciplined, and approximately 631,000 corruption cases were investigated in China in 2021.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.6","7B.9","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in September 2023; the quantitative 2021 finding is historical context for the continuing campaign during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The campaign is attributed to Xi Jinping's government and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.","limitations":["The count measures investigations, not proven corruption, convictions, recovered assets, or impartiality.","The extract does not provide a 2023 case count."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c61632bb39574c15","start_unit":12,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"In an online survey experiment with 2,317 Chinese respondents, perceived corruption was highest when investigation numbers showed an upward trend or a high recent number; mean perceived corruption was 4.34 for a continuous upward trend, 1.42 for a continuous downward trend, and an unexpected recent increase after a downward trend raised perceptions from 1.42 to 4.15.","question_ids":["7B.1","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2023 using an experiment conducted in early 2022; it provides a 2023-relevant institutional finding about how publicly disclosed anticorruption information affects perceptions.","ruler_attribution":"The experiment concerns public interpretation of the sustained anticorruption campaign under Xi's government, not a personal statement by Xi.","limitations":["Participants evaluated a fictitious country rather than China directly.","The sample represents social-media news consumers rather than the full Chinese population.","The result measures perceptions, not actual corruption or campaign effectiveness."]},{"source_id":"SRC-05d0bb39c87195b6","start_unit":8,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"The article finds that China's governance system remains top-down and centralized, with strong central policy levers and control over society; it also reports that policy-making is fragmented and negotiated, local officials adapt policies, and public opinion, NGOs, media, and the internet can exert pressure on state-centered policies.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2022 and describing the contemporary Xi-era system; relevant to 2023 institutional conditions but not a discrete 2023 event.","ruler_attribution":"The system-level features are attributed to China's CCP-led governance structure rather than solely to Xi personally.","limitations":["The article is a broad synthesis and does not isolate Xi's individual decisions.","The extract presents both central control and local adaptation without quantifying their relative effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-05d0bb39c87195b6","start_unit":20,"end_unit":22,"fact_summary":"Studies summarized in the special issue find that central government sets policy, vetoes local changes, establishes performance standards and quotas; migrant participation in urban social insurance remains low; and China's campaign-style COVID-19 crisis regime achieved some successes but lacked bottom-up information transmission, professional-community input, and adequate specialized capacity.","question_ids":["3B.9","6B.2","6B.6","6B.7","8B.5","8B.7","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2022 and summarizing contemporary evidence; the COVID findings concern the period before 2023 and provide inherited conditions for the target year.","ruler_attribution":"The crisis regime and central-local controls are attributed to the Chinese Party-state under Xi-era leadership.","limitations":["The extract does not provide Xi-specific orders or 2023 pandemic outcomes.","The social-insurance finding concerns local implementation and does not establish Xi's personal intent."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1ca45c08f485b778","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The article states that Xi endorsed ecological civilization at the 2012 Party Congress and that the concept was enshrined in China's Constitution in 2018 as a framework for sustainable development, environmental protection, green innovation, and public participation.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","6B.1","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Published in July 2023; the constitutional and policy facts predate 2023 but define the program in force during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"Xi's endorsement and the CCP-led constitutional framework are explicitly identified.","limitations":["Constitutional enshrinement and stated components do not establish effective implementation or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1ca45c08f485b778","start_unit":13,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"The Natural History Revival Movement provided an alternative environmental approach emphasizing public engagement, citizen monitoring, local knowledge, and civil-society associations; the article reports that birdwatching networks and environmental organizations generated data and influenced local conservation policies, while Xi-era social management made civic movements operate more cautiously.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.3","4B.7","6B.8","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2023 and describing contemporary Xi-era civic and environmental activity; the extract does not identify a specific 2023 policy change.","ruler_attribution":"The restrictions on civil-society space are attributed to Xi-era CCP social management; the movement's activities are societal rather than Xi-directed.","limitations":["The evidence concerns a specific environmental movement and cannot be generalized to all civil society.","The extract does not quantify state interference or the scale of policy influence in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a0d3bafaedc2a070","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The thesis concludes that Xi's ecological-civilization agenda produced short-term pollution improvements but was less effective in long-term reality than official claims; it identifies persistent carbon-emissions problems and continuing difficulties in balancing energy security, economic growth, and energy transition.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","6B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Submitted in December 2023 and directly evaluates the Xi-era environmental-governance trajectory through the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The environmental-governance record and energy-transition strategy are attributed to Xi Jinping's administration.","limitations":["The supplied abstract does not provide the underlying measurements, dates, or causal estimates.","The conclusion is a thesis-level assessment and contrasts with official claims without detailing every indicator."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a0d3bafaedc2a070","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The source records concrete Xi-era environmental measures and targets, including the 2021 inclusion of urban air quality in the 14th Five-Year Plan's binding indicators, central environmental inspections and accountability, a 2022 action plan for new pollutants, and a 2023 list placing fourteen new pollutants under priority control.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.7","6B.1","6B.2","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The measures span 2021-2023, with the fourteen-pollutant priority list occurring in March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The measures are part of the central environmental-governance system under Xi Jinping's leadership.","limitations":["The extract lists policies and implementation reports but does not establish their full enforcement or health outcomes.","Some cited reports are official and may present favorable selections."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a0d3bafaedc2a070","start_unit":20,"end_unit":27,"fact_summary":"The source's 2023 environmental evidence is mixed: China expanded renewable energy and clean-energy investment, but continued coal use, smog episodes, water and pollution risks, biodiversity loss, and unresolved energy-policy conflicts; external reporting also described China as both a major clean-energy leader and the world's largest coal consumer.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","6B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The cited materials include events and assessments from 2022-2023 and are directly relevant to the 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The energy and environmental trajectory is associated with Xi-era national policy, while some outcomes reflect market, regional, and external factors.","limitations":["This is a bibliography-heavy extract rather than a single quantified evaluation.","The listed reports vary in authority and may not be directly comparable."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied corpus contains abstracts, metadata, bibliographies, and extracted HTML rather than complete texts for several works; facts are limited to explicit claims in the supplied units.","The target period is 2023-2023, but many sources report earlier Xi-era policies or outcomes. Those records are retained only when they materially establish the institutional or programmatic conditions inherited into 2023.","No scores are assigned."]}
